homeTitle: seine — the fastest Blocknet miner for CPU and NVIDIA GPU
homeDescription: seine is the fastest miner for Blocknet, the Argon2id privacy coin. Tuned kernels for modern CPUs and NVIDIA GPUs, zero configuration, free and open source.
heroLead: Mines Blocknet on any modern CPU and NVIDIA GPU, and picks the fastest settings for your machine on its own. Free and open source.
step1Text: Each CPU thread uses about 2 GB of RAM. Seine sizes itself to your machine.
step2TextHtml: Double-click seine.exe on Windows. On macOS or Linux:
step3TextHtml: Or your @shortname. Accept the default pool and you're mining; seine keeps tuning itself as it runs.
dashboardAlt: The seine dashboard mining on bntpool from an Apple M4 Max at 30.6 H/s
perfSub: Seine tests its kernels on your machine while it mines and keeps the fastest one.
feat1Text: Separate Argon2id kernels for AVX2, AVX-512, Arm NEON and SHA3, plus NVIDIA GPUs.
feat2Text: Thread count, CPU kernel, memory and core placement are tested while you mine, with no restarts.
feat3Text: Every core and every NVIDIA GPU mines at once, and their hashrates add up.
feat4Text: Mines on bntpool.com out of the box, works with any Stratum pool, or solo against your own Blocknet node.
feat5Text: NUMA-aware placement, huge pages, a local control API with live events, and Prometheus metrics.
feat6Text: BSD-3 licensed, with checksums for every release archive.
